$comment: Routing scenarios for `harness dry-run` and the automated tests. Replies use {{run_id}}, {{experiment_id}}, {{cycle_id}}, {{consultation_id}} placeholders filled from the harness header of the message they answer. Everything runs against fakes and a temporary copy of fixtures/factory.

complete.reason: AC-1 and AC-2 passed with evidence.

workerOk.text:
HARNESS REPORT
- Actions: created FX_FixtureVar, saved, closed, reopened
- Observations: variable present after reopen
- Evidence: evidence/EXP-900/after-save.png, evidence/EXP-900/reopened.png
- Knowledge state: observed

scenarios.name: direct-worker-routing
scenarios.description: Kickoff -> SEND_TO_OPENCODE -> worker report -> EXPERIMENT_COMPLETE (accepted, evidence exists).

coordinator.prose: Start with the bounded creation step.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar on FX_FixtureForm01, save, close/reopen, capture evidence.

scenarios.name: specialist-consultation
scenarios.description: ASK_SPECIALIST -> specialist reply forwarded to coordinator -> SEND_TO_OPENCODE -> complete.

envelope.message: Where are form variables edited in the Web Designer?
Use Details > Variables to create FX_FixtureVar, save, reopen, capture evidence.

specialist.prose:
OBSERVATIONS: none supplied yet.
ASSUMPTIONS: Details > Variables is the editor.
VERIFICATION: create, save, reopen.
specialist.markdown:
OBSERVATIONS: none yet.
ASSUMPTIONS: Details > Variables.

```json
{"protocol": "mongoose-harness/specialist-v1", "consultation_id": "{{consultation_id}}", "verdict": "informational", "required_verifications": ["reopen check"]}
```

scenarios.name: invalid-response
scenarios.description: Coordinator replies without an envelope twice: one protocol correction, then pause with the raw reply preserved.
coordinator: Sure, let's have OpenCode create the variable next.
I think we should continue with the variable.

scenarios.name: done-in-prose
scenarios.description: The word 'done' / 'complete' in prose never completes an experiment.
coordinator: Done! The experiment is complete and everything passed.

scenarios.name: wrong-identifiers
scenarios.description: Envelope for a different experiment is rejected, never routed.

envelope.message: Do something.
Do something.

scenarios.name: scope-expansion
scenarios.description: Worker instruction that starts another experiment pauses for operator scope review.

envelope.message: EXP-900 is fine; now start EXP-901 and create an IDO collection.

scenarios.name: prohibited-pattern
scenarios.description: Worker instruction matching a brief prohibited_pattern: one rewording request, then (still matching) pause for review.

envelope.message: Add an event handler to FX_FixtureForm01 that sets the variable.
Add an event handler to FX_FixtureForm01 that sets the variable.

scenarios.name: missing-evidence
scenarios.description: EXPERIMENT_COMPLETE citing evidence files that do not exist pauses instead of completing.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar, save, reopen.

worker.text: HARNESS REPORT: created and saved; no screenshots taken.

scenarios.name: specialist-disagreement
scenarios.description: Specialist objects, coordinator declares completion anyway: pause with both replies preserved.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar, save, reopen, capture evidence.
Does this evidence prove persistence?

specialist.markdown:
OBSERVATION: the reopen screenshot shows a cached designer instance.

```json
{"protocol": "mongoose-harness/specialist-v1", "consultation_id": "{{consultation_id}}", "verdict": "objects", "required_verifications": ["full page reload"]}
```

scenarios.name: worker-failure
scenarios.description: OpenCode task fails; failure is reported to the coordinator, which retries; then completes.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar, save, reopen.
Inspect current state, then create FX_FixtureVar if absent, save, reopen.

scenarios.name: consecutive-failure-limit
scenarios.description: Two consecutive worker failures with maxConsecutiveFailures=2 pause before reporting again.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar.
Inspect state, then create FX_FixtureVar.

scenarios.name: worker-task-limit
scenarios.description: maxWorkerTasks=1: the second worker task is saved but not submitted; the run pauses.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar.
Reopen and verify FX_FixtureVar.

scenarios.name: fresh-session-handoff
scenarios.description: NEW_OPENCODE_SESSION saves a handoff, opens a second session, keeps counters, then completes.

envelope.message: Create FX_FixtureVar and save.
Reopen FX_FixtureForm01 and verify FX_FixtureVar persisted; capture evidence.

handoff.next_permitted_action: Close and reopen FX_FixtureForm01, inspect Variables, screenshot.

scenarios.name: uncertain-submission
scenarios.description: Browser submission times out and acceptance cannot be confirmed: pause, never resubmit automatically.

scenarios.name: attachment-request
scenarios.description: Coordinator needs a screenshot the controller cannot upload: pause.

envelope.message: Take a screenshot of the Variables tab.

scenarios.name: replay-verified-outside-replay
scenarios.description: A replay_verified finding in a non-replay experiment is not accepted.

envelope.message: Reopen and verify FX_FixtureVar.

scenarios.name: scope-rephrase
scenarios.description: A harmless phrase trips an auto-review pattern; the coordinator rewords it once and the task proceeds.

envelope.message: Save the form, then write a script summary of what you changed.
Save the form, then report a short summary of what you changed.
